status: designed (the owner approved the redesign); unlock timing is the story's, bond tiers are the bond engine's
concept: Power flows outward, through people: it grows with how many people you have truly bonded with and how deep those bonds go

contract.reads: dev.shinobi.combat.Kindle.Bonds, adapted by Shinobi Life's glue: tier(who) = Kindling.combatTier(w, who); web() = Kindling.bonfire(w).strength(); bonfireOpen() = Kindling.bonfire(w).lit()

tiers.bonfire: a large bond web (the bond engine's gate)

contract.quarrels: an active quarrel drops exactly one tier (a Spark goes out); a falling-out puts it out; nothing before the story's awakening (the bond engine decides; combat reads the tier)

thread_sight.combat: bonded allies' health, chakra and cooldowns show along their threads; a telegraphed attack on a bonded ally flares on its thread 4 ticks earlier (6 at Flame, 8 at Blaze) so you can Cover or parry for them; any bonded ally is a beacon anywhere on the map
thread_sight.blind_spot: strangers and enemies have no thread to you: no reads on them
thread_sight.outside_combat: the bond engine's (who is tied to whom, fraying and one-sided ties, lies as a flicker)

kindle.key: Kindle (K) while a bonded ally weaves: your chakra goes into their technique
kindle.cost: your chakra: 0.6 / 0.8 / 1.0 of the ally's technique cost (Spark / Flame / Blaze)
kindle.examples: a fireball becomes a firestorm, a heal becomes a revival, a sensor's range covers the village
kindle.rule: you never learn the technique: they do it, bigger

ember_link.members: you and up to 3 bonded allies within 24 blocks
ember_link.shared_pool: one chakra pool: a caster pays from their own share first, then evenly from the others
ember_link.damage: a hit on a linked member: the one struck keeps half, the rest is split across the others (you feel your allies' pain)
ember_link.sight: look through a linked ally's eyes (hold the Link key)

unison.rule: a combination unique to each pairing that neither can do alone: your nature crossed with the ally's niche (and their nature)
unison.cost: 25 chakra each, once per fight per pairing
unison.power: two A-rank casts in one blow (42 base), 4-block burst

by_niche.genjutsu: Painted <your nature>: enemies caught in the ally's illusion take your nature's damage every second and cannot release it while it burns
by_niche.taijutsu: Twin Comet: both dash through the target; your nature coats the strike (with a ninken: three fangs)
by_niche.ninjutsu: a nature unison: the two natures' combo (combos/nature.json) at twice the power and range, or a pure-chakra lance when the natures match
by_niche.medical: Hearth: the squad heals as one and a downed member rises
by_niche.sensing: Beacon Sight: every enemy within 48 blocks marked, hidden ones revealed, for 30 s
by_niche.weapons: Ember Rain: the ally's weapon storm carries your nature
by_niche.sealing: Burning Seal: a barrier that burns what it holds

ember_mark.what: leave an ember in a deeply bonded ally: travel to their side, or summon them to yours, across any distance
ember_mark.combat: once per fight: swap places with a marked ally (an escape or a rescue); outside a fight, travel to them (5-minute cooldown)

bonfire.strength: the bond engine's Bonfire strength (Kindling.bonfire(w).strength(): each flame by tier 1/2/4 times its strength, dimmed by quarrels, plus 0.5 per community reached)
bonfire.formula: m = 1 + 1.5 x (1 - e^(-strength / 35)): your damage x m, damage taken x 1/sqrt(m), chakra regen x (1 + strength / 25), allies' power x (1 + (m - 1) / 2)
bonfire.forms: candle under 5, campfire under 12, bonfire under 21, inferno above (the bond engine's names; the visuals match)
bonfire.burnout: afterwards no kindling of any kind for 60 s, and the chakra bar empties

costs: while linked you feel your allies' pain (the damage split)
past three kindles in a minute each burns 10% of your chakra bar and 30 stamina
a quarrel dims that person's flame, a falling-out snuffs it
useless with strangers until you bond with them
natures: you still gain natures through bonds by resonance: fight beside someone often enough and their trial can teach you their nature (the bond engine counts, a nature master's trial teaches); you never copy it
look: an ember mark on the palm or chest (never an eye), threads of light, ember-gold chakra
beta: none of it ships in the beta; the story decides when Spark opens
